jobs.description:

jobs.title: Armed Hospital Security Guard — Night Shifts, Daily Pay
jobs.description:
Cascadia Global Security is seeking an Armed Security Guard in Seguin, TX. The full-time position requires a valid Armed Texas guard license, firearm/armor readiness, and the ability to pass health screenings and a DMV background check.

You will patrol client sites, deter threats, and maintain safety while documenting daily activities. Candidates must be 21 or older, possess a driver’s license, and be able to work mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

jobs.title: Armed Level III Security Officer – San Antonio | Medical
jobs.description:
TriCorps is hiring an Armed Level III Security Officer for our San Antonio, TX location. The role involves protecting employees and property, controlling access, and delivering courteous service with a professional presence on site.

Candidates must hold a valid Texas PSB Level III Armed license and demonstrate reliability, sound judgment, and adaptability across day and night shifts. Full-time and part-time shifts are available, with benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
